adventurez.port.assets.pack_description: Textures, models and sounds from your original AdventureZ jar
adventurez.port.assets.title: AdventureZ — unofficial NeoForge port
adventurez.port.assets.text: The original textures, models and sounds are copyrighted (All Rights Reserved), so they are not included in this port. Download the original mod for Fabric 1.21.1 and put the jar into the resourcepacks folder — the port will use only its graphics and sounds from it. You do not need to put it into the mods folder.
